The DailyMed database contains 159125 labeling submitted to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) by companies. DailyMed does not contain a complete listing of labeling for FDA-regulated products (e.g., labeling that is not submitted to the FDA). See ABOUT DAILYMED for more information. The rule takes effect March 7, 2033. Posted: September 15, 2021 The RxImage API will cease operation on December 31, 2021. DailyMed will be removing pill images provided by the RxImage API on October 31, 2021. Pill images
